officialWindowCards.text: DEGS1-mTORC1-driven lipid metabolic reprogramming fuels rhabdomyosarcoma progression and unveils a therapeutic vulnerability Rhabdomyosarcoma is an aggressive childhood cancer with limited treatment options for advanced disease. Here, the authors show that the ceramide-pathway associated enzyme DEGS1 regulates muscle stem cells inducing tumor progression through mTORC1 and lipid metabolism, revealing a target for rhabdomyosarcoma. officialWindowCards.text: Increasing dengue outbreaks in temperate Brazil are associated with Aedes aegypti invasion and infestation levels Dengue is surging in temperate southern Brazil. This study links the rise to the spread and increasing infestation levels of Aedes aegypti, rather than to shifts in climate suitability, and shows that viral lineages persist locally for years.
